title: palcheck header promises checks the code never performs
evidence:
+// this gate would have caught it: it scans the BLESSED juice goldens for the
+// exact canon hexes (house bodies AND roofs, the host, the LED green, the
+// play-marking) ... +// Everything is exact-color counting over the rlsw readback (normalized: ... +		img := rl.LoadImageFromScreen()
detail: No body-hex check exists anywhere in the file, and the zoomed-lane check counts a fresh GPU framebuffer capture, not the rlsw readback. The gate's documented oracle overstates what is enforced.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the header to match reality (roofs/host/marking/LED/hardware only; note the GPU capture in section 2), or add the promised body checks and move section 2 onto the rlsw path.

title: contact shadow is an alpha-blended fill despite the recorded rlsw alpha divergence
detail: Lines were pre-composited because rlsw ignores alpha, but the new shadow ellipse's alpha behavior is unverified. If fills behave like lines, blessed goldens show an opaque ink blob where the app shows a 33% shadow.
recommended_fix: Verify rlsw ellipse-fill alpha; if opaque, pre-composite the shadow toward the canvas exactly like the halo/outline fixes, and pin the shadow tone in palcheck.

title: palcheck: HOUSE_BODIES and HOST_BODY constants never referenced
detail: Declared canon constants with no consuming check (only HOUSE_ROOFS, HOST_ROOF, LED_GREEN, LANE_AMBER, STATE_CRITICAL are used). Leftovers of the dropped body scan invite false confidence.
recommended_fix: Delete the unused constants, or implement the body-hex checks the header claims — noting they cannot pass while the top-down camera occludes wall tones.

title: gen_sprites.py: CREAM and DC_VENT hexes never used
detail: No code path references CREAM or DC_VENT; the dc cooling units shade DC_ROOF instead of the vent tone. Dead palette entries drift silently from the look-book.
recommended_fix: Remove both constants or actually use DC_VENT for the cooling units as the name implies.

title: draw_packets header still describes the pre-7.1 lane-order queue pile
detail: The function doc says queued packets pile at the departure node in lane order; 7.1 replaced that with a doorstep fan keyed by packet id. The retained comment now contradicts the code beneath it.
recommended_fix: Update the draw_packets header comment to the doorstep-fan behavior.

title: CI invokes tools/harness.sh palcheck but no hunk adds the subcommand
evidence:
+      - name: Sprite/palette presence scan (the look-book §2 palette oracle)
+        run: tools/harness.sh palcheck ... +  "Sprite/palette presence scan (the look-book §2 palette oracle — 7.1)|tools/harness.sh palcheck"
detail: Both CI and ci-local call the wrapper script, but the diff contains no change to tools/harness.sh. Unless it generically forwards verbs, palcheck never runs (or errors) in both gates.
recommended_fix: Confirm harness.sh dispatches arbitrary verbs to the harness binary; if not, add the palcheck dispatch hunk.

title: banner focus-zoom with empty selection has no click-to-exit
evidence:
+		if app.input.sel_node != app.last_sel_node || app.input.sel_pipe != app.last_sel_pipe {
+			camera_set_selection(&app)
+		} ... +	// the nav-zoom's exit even with NOTHING selected (the selection-diff alone
+	// never fires when the selection was already empty — Perkins r1 W3).
detail: Alerts-as-nav zooms without changing selection; with nothing selected, clicking empty world space produces no selection diff, so the camera stays zoomed until ESC/pad-B or a new selection.
recommended_fix: On a world click that deselects (even a no-op deselect), also call camera_set_fit, or track the camera focus source so any deselect returns home.

title: crisis banner text-layout constants duplicated between rect proc and draw
detail: crisis_banner_rect single-sources the card rect, but card_w and line_h are re-declared in draw_crisis_banner for text layout; editing one copy silently desyncs the drawn text from the card and hit-rect.
recommended_fix: Hoist card_w/pad/title_h/line_h into shared named constants used by both crisis_banner_rect and draw_crisis_banner.

title: adjacent SLA hit rects overlap 2px; the lower row is unreachable there
detail: Rows pitch 16px but rects are 18px tall (y-2..y+16), so consecutive rects overlap 2px; iteration order makes the upper row swallow clicks in that band. The highlight chips overlap identically.
recommended_fix: Make the rect 16px tall (or pitch rows 18px) so hit rects tile without overlap.

title: look-book trailer edited in this PR still says it targets main
evidence: +*End of look-book v1 + the 7.1 amendment. Source: `blend-sources/pp_lib.py` + `.blend` + `tools/gen_sprites.py`. On approval these renders + this doc + the sources commit and a PR opens targeting `main` (never merged by the minion).*
detail: The trailer line was rewritten in this diff yet keeps 'a PR opens targeting `main`' while PR #64 bases the v2 branch. The amended canon documents a stale target.
recommended_fix: Update the trailer to name the actual base branch (v2).

title: no automated coverage for the new interaction surfaces
detail: camera_update/camera_set_selection easing, crisis_banner_click, and sla_focus_click have no harness or parity scenario; goldens capture at fit with focus off, so hit-test or easing regressions are invisible to CI.
recommended_fix: Add parity scenarios (banner click, row focus toggle, cancel-to-home) or a harness check that exercises the hit-test procs against constructed app state.
